rules.penalty: Wrongful eviction damages of at least three times actual economic damages; at least three times required relocation assistance for failure to pay it; possible punitive damages and attorney's fees.
rules.title: San Diego Residential Tenant Protections (just cause and relocation)
rules.citation: San Diego Mun. Code ch. 9, art. 8, div. 7
rules.requirement: Your landlord cannot end your tenancy without a just cause listed in the law, such as unpaid rent or the owner moving in. For no-fault evictions, the landlord must pay relocation help equal to two months' rent (three months if you are a senior or disabled), either in cash or by waiving rent.
rules.requirement_es: Su propietario no puede terminar su arrendamiento sin una causa justa indicada en la ley, como renta no pagada o que el dueño se mude a la vivienda. En desalojos sin culpa, el propietario debe pagar ayuda de reubicación igual a dos meses de renta (tres meses si usted es una persona mayor o tiene una discapacidad), en efectivo o eximiendo la renta.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property in the City of San Diego, including mobilehome park units, with a tenancy of more than 30 days, unless exempt.
rules.quote: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
